claim: Test correctness can be bypassed: a held-out test's pass/fail pattern is scored for agreement (LOO-AUC) with the ranking induced by all remaining tests, and expected LOO-AUC is proportional to the test's discriminative power.
stance_target: L4 self-written test adequacy has a formal occupant
quoted_support: We formalize this agreement as the leave-one-out AUC (LOO-AUC) and prove that the expected LOO-AUC is proportional to each test's ability to separate correct code from incorrect code.

breadth.confidence_families: test-weight scores from the binary pass matrix (LOO-AUC); no model confidence
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: GPT-3.5-Turbo candidates; GPT-4, DeepSeek-Coder, CodeLlama as direct-inference baselines (Table 2)
breadth.label_source: ground-truth tests of each benchmark; LLM-generated tests used as signals
breadth.label_independence: selection signal uses generated tests, labels use benchmark tests
breadth.granularity: per-test weights over candidates (test-level, not requirement-level)
